target.title: docs(line): document missing threadBindings config and responsePrefix
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/line/src/config-schema.ts` defines `ThreadBindingsSchema` (5 active sub-fields + 2 deprecated aliases for session binding lifecycle) and `responsePrefix`, but `docs/channels/line.md` does not document the `threadBindings` config object or the `responsePrefix` field. Users configuring LINE cannot discover these features from the docs.

- Problem: The `threadBindings` config object and `responsePrefix` exist in the LINE config schema/types but are absent from the docs
- Solution: Add a "Thread bindings" section with config example and field descriptions (matching the Discord docs pattern), plus a `responsePrefix` mention in the Message behavior section
- What changed: `docs/channels/line.md` (+28 lines — new H2 section + 1 line in Message behavior), `docs/docs_map.md` (+1 line for new heading)
- What did NOT change: No code or behavior changes. Documentation only.

**Missing fields**:
1. **`threadBindings`** — object controlling how LINE conversations bind to agent sessions:
   - `enabled` (boolean) — toggle thread bindings
   - `idleHours` (number) — inactivity threshold before binding is considered idle
   - `maxAgeHours` (number) — maximum binding lifetime
   - `spawnSessions` (boolean) — spawn a new session on first message
   - `defaultSpawnContext` (`"fork"` (default) | `"isolated"`) — session context mode
   - `spawnSubagentSessions` / `spawnAcpSessions` — deprecated, migrated by `openclaw doctor --fix`
2. **`responsePrefix`** (string) — prepended to every outbound reply

## Evidence

### Schema — `ThreadBindingsSchema` (`extensions/line/src/config-schema.ts:12-22`)

```typescript
const ThreadBindingsSchema = z
  .object({
    enabled: z.boolean().optional(),
    idleHours: z.number().optional(),
    maxAgeHours: z.number().optional(),
    spawnSessions: z.boolean().optional(),
    defaultSpawnContext: z.enum(["isolated", "fork"]).optional(),
    spawnSubagentSessions: z.boolean().optional(),
    spawnAcpSessions: z.boolean().optional(),
  })
  .strict();
```

### Schema — `responsePrefix` via `ReplyRuntimeConfigSchemaShape` (`src/config/zod-schema.core.ts:657`)

```typescript
responsePrefix: z.string().optional(),
```

The LINE config schema extends `LineCommonConfigSchemaBase` which spreads `ReplyRuntimeConfigSchemaShape`, inheriting `responsePrefix` alongside other reply-formatting fields.

### Runtime types (`extensions/line/src/types.ts:7-15,30,33`)

```typescript
interface LineThreadBindingsConfig {
  enabled?: boolean;
  idleHours?: number;
  maxAgeHours?: number;
  spawnSessions?: boolean;
  defaultSpawnContext?: "isolated" | "fork";
  /** @deprecated Use spawnSessions instead. */
  spawnSubagentSessions?: boolean;
  /** @deprecated Use spawnSessions instead. */
  spawnAcpSessions?: boolean;
}

responsePrefix?: string;
threadBindings?: LineThreadBindingsConfig;
```

Note: `spawnSubagentSessions` and `spawnAcpSessions` are deprecated in favor of `spawnSessions`. The doc follows the Discord docs pattern — keeping them out of the normal example and noting deprecation in a separate line.

### Runtime default — `defaultSpawnContext` (`src/channels/thread-bindings-policy.ts:212-216`)

```typescript
const defaultSpawnContext =
  normalizeSpawnContext(account?.defaultSpawnContext) ??
  normalizeSpawnContext(root?.defaultSpawnContext) ??
  normalizeSpawnContext(params.cfg.session?.threadBindings?.defaultSpawnContext) ??
  "fork";  // ← runtime default
```

### Test confirmation (`src/channels/thread-bindings-policy.test.ts:84`)

```typescript
expect(policy.defaultSpawnContext).toBe("fork");
```

### Sibling docs reference — Discord (`docs/channels/discord.md:803,808`)

- `defaultSpawnContext` controls native subagent context for thread-bound spawns. Default: `"fork"`.
- Deprecated `spawnSubagentSessions`/`spawnAcpSessions` keys are migrated by `openclaw doctor --fix`.

## User Impact

Users can now discover the `threadBindings` config object and its 5 active sub-fields (plus 2 deprecated aliases) from the LINE channel docs, as well as the `responsePrefix` option. The documented `defaultSpawnContext` default (`"fork"`) matches the actual runtime behavior. These fields were already functional — they were simply invisible to users who configure via docs.
